title: Sync
subtitle: Strava sync health
connected: Strava connected. The backfill is queued and shows up below.
connectFailedHint: Strava did not finish the connection. Try again.
refreshFailed: Refresh failed, showing the last known state
noStravaHint: Connect Strava to start the first backfill.

rate.title: Strava rate limit
rate.pauses: Backfill pauses above 80% of the 15-minute budget.

strava_auth.title: Strava connection expired
strava_auth.body: Strava no longer accepts trainsync's access. Reconnect to keep syncing.

deauthorized.title: Strava access was removed
deauthorized.body: trainsync's access was revoked in Strava. Reconnect to sync again.

strava_unavailable.title: Strava was unreachable
strava_unavailable.body: Strava did not answer. The next sync tries again on its own.

strava_rejected.title: Strava turned down a request
strava_rejected.body: The next sync tries again. If this keeps happening, reconnect Strava.

internal.title: Sync failed
internal.body: Something went wrong on our side. The next sync tries again on its own.
